rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: The protocol is headed 'Выборы Президента Российской Федерации. Повторное голосование 3 июля 1996 года'.

rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: The CEC, summing 89 subject-commission protocols and 397 protocols of polling stations abroad, determines: 108,600,730 voters on the lists; 73,926,240 valid and 780,405 invalid ballots; 74,815,898 voters took part in the election; 'ЕЛЬЦИН БОРИС НИКОЛАЕВИЧ' 40,208,384 votes; 'ЗЮГАНОВ ГЕННАДИЙ АНДРЕЕВИЧ' 30,113,306; against all 3,604,550. Chairman N. T. Ryabov heads the signature block. 'Протокол составлен 9 июля 1996 года'.

bounded_scope: Presidency observations for CLAUDE-C01-14 only. Election calling, voting, result determination, declaration, correction and publication, oath, stated assumption of office, inauguration ceremony, resignation, acting service and outgoing-holder statements stay separate rows; holder boundaries are decided in the packet, not by any row.
